# Negative nominal-record fixtures

This directory freezes Slice 4.1 rejection boundaries for duplicate root and
field names, unknown or missing fields, wrong field values, wrong-kind nominal
references, embedded recursion, and forbidden shorthand.

Within the ecosystem each immutable source owns an exact failure class,
diagnostic code, and original-byte span in the Stage 4 oracle set.
